items.name: CBRE Group Inc Common Stock Class A
items.label: Quarterly report

performance.driver: Revenue increased 12.7% reflecting double-digit growth across the Advisory Services and Building Operations & Experience (BOE) segments and single-digit growth in the Project Management segment, partially offset by a decrease in revenue in the Real Estate Investments (REI) segment.

items.name: CBRE Group Inc Common Stock Class A
items.label: Reported results

performance.driver: Revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 increased $484.0 million, or 8.1%, from the prior year comparable period. The increase in revenue was driven by organic revenue growth of 5.7%, primarily in our Climate & Sustainability Technologies and Clean Energy & Fueling segments, acquisition-related growth of 1.2% primarily in our Pumps & Process Solutions segment, and a favorable impact from foreign currency translation of 1.2%.

items.name: Five Point Holdings LLC Class A
items.label: Reported results

performance.driver: Total revenue increased 8% in the third quarter of 2026, and 4% in the nine months ended September 30, 2026, reflecting higher operating revenue and fuel revenue due to higher prices passed through to customers.

Net revenue decreased by $17.4 million, or 3.2%, to $520.1 million for the thirteen weeks ended September 26, 2026, as compared to $537.5 million for the thirteen weeks ended September 27, 2025 primarily due to decreased sales volume impacts of $26.4 million, partially offset by favorable product mix of $7.7 million, and increased pricing of $4.9 million.

Net sales of $1,183.7 million in the third quarter of 2026 represented a decrease of $7.1 million, or 0.6%, from 2025 levels, reflecting a $33.1 million, or 2.8%, organic decline, partially offset by $25.6 million of acquisition-related sales and $0.4 million of favorable foreign currency translation.
